summary: Repair Web V2 history read cancellation storms, repeated unauthenticated polling and duplicate coordination board requests; preserve background Run identity, secure login and responsive mobile UI.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing Web V2 browser API/session/SSE/coordination read paths. Server WebSessionStore cookie validation, Run generation, Lane/CAS, Host authority, login password and CSRF remain unchanged.
components.disposition: Coalesce concurrent history reads for the same session without cancelling each other; preserve one trailing read for final/sync changes; never treat unknown Run status as ended. Report exact HTTP 401 to a non-authoritative browser UI store, stop passive GET polling and SSE reconnects, and offer same-origin re-login without replaying user turns. Share one in-flight read of existing coordination board between two panels. Preserve three-state missing/error/normal UI, old data, permission/CSRF and mobile navigation.
evidence: Production read-only web.log showed repeated 401 for messages, board, jobs, schedule, continuity, interop and escalation after browser cookie invalidation; server WebSessionStore is intentionally in-memory and revoked on Web process restart.
Read-only localhost GET for a 3.44MB session recent 100 messages returned HTTP200 in 0.419s; board 0.17-0.24s; sessions list 0.98s. This does not prove all timeout cases are resolved.

New focused regression coverage: HTTP 401 stop/relogin, shared board in-flight coalescing, same-session history singleflight, owner-switch stale guard, terminal trailing read, unknown Run status, SSE close, safe login banner.
components.verification_level: WebUI targeted and full Vitest, TypeScript and build required; exact SHA independent Reviewer PASS P0/P1=0, original R9 exit0 and remote CI required before protected merge; production PC/mobile and service health to be verified only after managed deployment.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Client-side auth-required flag never grants authorization or bypasses server login. Explicit writes are not auto-replayed; unknown Run status stays unknown. A failed history/board read cannot be interpreted as an empty session or completed Run. Only successful browser re-auth and page reload restore passive polling; no key/cookie material is persisted.
components.rollback_route: Protected revert of the bounded WebUI-only patch followed by a single managed service update when no active Run remains; previous Generation 448/source bundle retained for rollback. Do not touch PR #105 or other Goals/Lanes.
